description: Runs a deterministic 90-day B2B revenue leakage and Visa CE 3.0 readiness audit across caller-supplied Stripe subscriptions (2025-03-31.basil item-level periods), usage events, and disputes.

customers.description: Array of Stripe customer objects with subscriptions ({ id, subscriptions: { data, has_more } }).

demo.description: Set true only to generate a labeled sample preview when customers/usageEvents are omitted.

disputes.description: Optional array of Stripe dispute objects.

usageEvents.description: Array of metered API/SaaS usage events ({ customer_id, event_name, occurred_at }).

name: revclamp_audit_revenue_leakage
